Scott Feld Why Your Friends Have More Friends Than You Do published AJS 96(6) May 1991

Newman 2002 and 2003 used correlation/mixing models and show effects on percolation and removal robustness
Undirected local clustering C_i=2 t_i/[k_i(k_i-1)] for degree>=2, mean local Cbar and global transitivity 3T/sum choose(k_i,2) are different measures
